scientific.claim_scope: Weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators on the real four-dimensional exterior algebra, modulo algebra-automorphism conjugacy.
scientific.integrity: The infinite classification is proved symbolically from the algebra structure; the bundled checker verifies all displayed normal forms, automorphisms, conjugation formulas, and invariants.
scientific.limitations: The classification is over the real field only and does not cover nonzero weight or arbitrary-field square-class refinements.

title: Automorphism orbits of weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators on the real Grassmann plane
